notes: Virginia publishes no committee-only deadline distinct from crossover for a bill's ORIGINATING chamber — committee action on own-chamber bills must conclude by the same crossover date (2026-02-17), so committeeCutoffDate mirrors crossoverDate here (not a duplication error). secondCommitteeCutoffDate (2026-03-09) is the second/opposite-chamber committee deadline. The budget bill runs on a separate sub-schedule (e.g. Budget Sunday committee deadline 2026-02-22) not captured here. A reconvened/veto session is scheduled 2026-04-22, after sineDie.
